about: Clearwater County is a municipal district in west-central Alberta between Rocky Mountain House and the foothills toward Banff country—not a city. Ranchland, oil and gas lease roads, and mountain approaches along the North Saskatchewan and Clearwater rivers define a vast rural territory. About 12,000 people live in Clearwater County.
